composition_notes: Long melodic spans are set over delicate inner arpeggios; the late return rises an octave.
A phrase-length singing melody now grows over the retained arpeggios; the late octave ascent remains deliberate, and the final leading tone resolves upward.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
